messages:
Zoey - MKTG: Quick visual sprint for the Serving Wins launch. Need: landing hero, 1 benchmark slide w/ sparkline, inbound routing PNG for ops, and three micro-explainers (latency, cost, quality). First pass by Tue noon.

Marco (Design): Understood. Which hero crop first and illustration tone?

Zoey - MKTG: Desktop hero first (we'll crop to mobile). Tone: clean + data-forward; include a small schematic inset for caching/routing.

Aya - Creative Ops: Uploaded starter file and component set: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/servekit. Use comp set rdw/micro-compact. I added localization tokens (EN/FR/DE) and export presets.

Marco (Design): Thanks. Draft export specs: hero 1400x800 (svg + 72dpi png), microtile 600x600 (svg/png), slide 1920x1080 (pptx + png), routing 1100x800 (svg). Will layer copy tokens.

Eli - Brand: Use stacked mark for hero, no effects on logos, palette from /brand/palettes/visual.csv. Ensure contrast >=4.5:1 for small type. Sparkline: SVG for slide and 3s MP4 for social.

Priyanka PMM: Micro-explainers audience split: dev (latency + tokens/sec), platform (SLA + private), finance (cost/unit + batching). Short CTAs: "Try demo" / "Estimate cost" / "Contact sales". I'll post 1-line copy by 15:00.

Marco (Design): I'll mock hero + routing tonight and push frames into Figma. Please confirm filename pattern for exports.

Zoey - MKTG: Naming: rdw_servingwins_<asset>_<audience>_v1. Example rdw_servingwins_microtile_dev_v1.png. Also need alt text lines for each asset in the handoff.

Aya - Creative Ops: I'll prepare the handoff_readme (figma link, export list, alt_text.md, manifest.csv) and run accessibility checks before uploads.

Marco (Design): Pushing frames now. Tagging @Aya when ready for exports.

Figma Bot: Frame "servingwins-hero-v1" created by Marco (Design) at 2026-03-28T22:11:05Z.

Zoey - MKTG: Thanks all 680. Please ping #marketing-ops when the slide PNG is ready for rehearsal.
